PHOTO_READING.TITLE: Read a device photo with AI
PHOTO_READING.TIPS: Photograph one blood pressure monitor or glucometer. Keep all digits and the unit sharp, well lit, and free of glare. Include only the device, not your face or personal details.
PHOTO_READING.PREVIEW_ALT: Device photo to check against the extracted reading
PHOTO_READING.CONSENT: I agree to send this photo through VitaLink to {{provider}} to read the device display. AI can make mistakes. VitaLink does not store the photo; {{provider}} processes it under its data policies, which may allow retention. Do not include faces, names, or other identifying details.
PHOTO_READING.ERROR_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED: The AI provider configuration has changed. Select your photo again and review the updated provider consent before sending it.
PHOTO_READING.EXTRACTED: Values have been copied into the form below. Compare them with the photo before saving. The measurement time is not read from the device.
PHOTO_READING.REVIEW: I checked the values, units, and measurement time against my device and corrected any mistakes.
PHOTO_READING.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Check the extracted values, units, and measurement time before saving.
PHOTO_READING.PULSE_RANGE_ERROR: Pulse must be a whole number between 30 and 220 bpm.
PHOTO_READING.MANUAL_HINT: Internet access is required for AI. You can always enter values manually. HI, LO, or error displays cannot be imported as numeric readings.
PHOTO_READING.ERROR_OFFLINE: Photo reading needs an internet connection. Enter values manually or try again when online.
PHOTO_READING.ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE: Choose a clear JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo up to 20 MB. Crop to the device display if the provider's upload limit is smaller. If your phone uses HEIC, retake or export it as JPEG.
PHOTO_READING.ERROR_UNREADABLE: We could not read a reliable value for this device. Retake the photo with the digits and unit visible, or enter the reading manually. For HI, LO, or an error message, follow your device instructions.
PHOTO_READING.ERROR_UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign in again to read a photo.
PHOTO_READING.ERROR_RATE_LIMITED: You have reached the photo-reading limit. Wait and try again, or enter values manually.
PHOTO_READING.ERROR_UNAVAILABLE: Photo reading is unavailable. Try again later or enter values manually.
